context: The pages list is the whole document; there is no external data source. The layout result pads the ordered document by appending the reserved ID __BLANK__ until the length is a multiple of four; for this 13-page input, padded_pages is the 13 page IDs in their original order followed by __BLANK__, __BLANK__, __BLANK__, and sheet_count is 4. Build the sheets from a working copy of that padded list, outside sheet first. For sheet 1, then sheet 2, and so on up to sheet_count, take four IDs from the remaining list in exactly this order: front_left is the LAST remaining ID, front_right is the FIRST remaining ID, back_left is the next FIRST remaining ID, and back_right is the next LAST remaining ID. Remove each ID once it is placed, then repeat for the next sheet using what is left. Number sheets from 1. Do not fill sheets in reading order, sort IDs, swap sides, rotate anything, drop __BLANK__ entries, or move them elsewhere. Copy every page ID exactly, including capitalization, leading and trailing spaces and Unicode; do not trim or normalize. The output task field must be the original input object unchanged, and the run token must be copied unchanged from the layout result. The sheets list must contain exactly sheet_count entries, each with its sheet number and the four slot fields.
